argv: Pause, then hold Stop; on another
the owner's AllTrails size and place (fix walk-strip-buttons, decision 0220)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a walk, tap …, then Pause, then hold Stop; on another, Pause, then Resume and walk on. **Expect:** walking, the strip shows the numbers, … (it opens the walk's options) and a wide Pause, no Stop; paused, a wide orange Resume and a round Stop, no …, the numbers whole on a small phone; held, an orange fill sweeps across Stop and the replay opens; Resume records again (decision 0220).
